TITLE: Board View No-Results Page – Magnifier's Grey Circle Cannot Be Seen on the Grey Board
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10046 (Board View — board by lead technician; Ready for QA, read live 16 Oct 2026 — re-read before the ask) · PRIORITY: Medium · LINK: relates to SV-10046
ALREADY REPORTED: none found among SV-11317 to SV-11326, SV-11338, SV-11393 to SV-11398 (titles read live 16 Oct 2026). SV-11319 is about the icon drawings, not this circle.
SEEN ON: staging build {{v26.40.18-7d85b7d}}, 16 Oct 2026 (run 498, C590122).
STATUS: DRAFT — NOT FILED. One ask per ticket; the QA lead decides (Rule 62/113).

h2. Description

*When filters return no work orders, Board View should show the same empty state as List, with List's magnifier in a round grey circle.* In Board View the circle is drawn in the same grey as the board behind it, so only a bare magnifier can be seen.

For example,
* List and Tech View show the magnifier inside a visible light-grey circle
* Board View shows the same words and button, but no circle around the magnifier

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Board View* in the display switcher.
# Click *Status*, tick *Paid*, press Escape, and type {{zzzz}} in *Search*.
#* "No work orders match these filters", "Try removing a filter to widen your results." and *Clear all filters* show in the middle of the board.
#* The magnifier above them has no visible circle around it.
# Click *List* in the display switcher.
#* The same words and button show, and the magnifier sits in a light-grey circle.

*Actual Result:*
* Board View's no-results page shows a bare magnifier; its grey circle cannot be seen against the grey board.

*Expected Result:*
* As the test expects: *"Step 7: the board is replaced by an empty state centred on the page: List's magnifier icon in a round grey circle, the title "No work orders match these filters", the hint "Try removing a filter to widen your results." and a Clear all filters button."*
